parameters.name: flight_valid
parameters.doc: 1 when the flight is legal; 0 for a rule breach the simulator cannot see (lost part, flight-zone breach, failed static test)

parameters.name: pilot_external
parameters.doc: 1 when an external pilot flies the round (S_pilot = 0.75, eq. 7)

terms.name: b_to
terms.expr: if(takeoff_distance > announced_takeoff, 0, step(announced_takeoff, 20 m, 1.25, 40 m, 1.125, 60 m, 1, 0))

score.round_expr: (((p_weight + p_time + p_glide + p_alt) * flight_valid + b_load) * b_to) * s_pilot

reference_field.name: c_max
reference_field.note: ASSUMPTION: most water carried by any team in the round (4 L); no published figure

reference_field.name: t_min
reference_field.note: ASSUMPTION: fastest 1 km time of the round; no published figure

reference_field.name: te_max
reference_field.note: ASSUMPTION: longest glide of the round; no published figure

reference_field.name: ct_max
reference_field.note: ASSUMPTION: best C/sqrt(t_load) of the round, e.g. 4 L in 44 s; no published figure
